heater_stalled.title: {name} stopped responding
heater_stalled.description: Home Assistant hasn't heard the heater for over a minute while its Bluetooth proxy is online: its Bluetooth has most likely stopped, and only a power cycle restarts it. If your installation has a mains isolator switch: switch it off, wait at least 5 seconds, then switch it on. If there is no isolator switch: switch off the circuit breaker or remove the fuse supplying the unit, wait at least 5 seconds, then switch it on. Home Assistant reconnects automatically. (A phone app connected to the heater also blocks it: the heater accepts one connection at a time.)

schedule_pending.title: {name}: schedule change waiting
schedule_pending.description: The heater couldn't be reached when its schedule was changed. Home Assistant keeps the change and writes it as soon as the heater answers again; until then the heater keeps running its previous schedule.
